allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection, searching, and listing of files inside the workspace, except sensitive files.
Allow read-only Git inspection such as status, diff, log, show, and blame.
block_instructions: Require approval before tests, builds, compilation, type checks, validation, linting, formatting, or automated diagnostics.
Require approval before package installation, restore, audit, update, publishing, dependency resolution, code generation, migrations, or data seeding.
Require approval before starting applications, development servers, containers, deployments, infrastructure operations, benchmarks, coverage, or security scans.
Require approval before destructive file or Git operations, including deletion, clean, reset, restore, checkout that discards changes, force operations, or history rewrites.
Block reading or writing .env files, secret directories, private keys, credentials, tokens, and authentication material.
